name: Kaioken Search
summary: Kaioken Search is a structural module for the kaioken/search directory (an npm package). It builds and queries a hybrid search index over markdown content in a repository. The implementation bundles a stopword-aware analyzer with a Porter stemmer, a BM25 lexical scorer with phrase bonus and reciprocal rank fusion, a corpus collector that walks markdown files and splits them into chunks, and an on-disk search index that supports optional semantic embeddings and hybrid ranking.
keyPoints: The analyzer (src/analyze.ts) lowercases, strips stopwords (via a STOPWORDS set), splits camelCase/snake_case identifiers, and applies a Porter-style stemmer to tokens; tokens shorter than 2 chars are dropped.

The BM25 module (src/bm25.ts) implements a Lexicon class built from chunked documents, with BM25 scoring (K1=1.2, B=0.75), IDF, phrase bonus (for exact phrase matches), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF with K=60), and cosine similarity.

The corpus module (src/corpus.ts) collects docs and chunks by walking markdown files under wiki/, cards/, skills/, and symbols/ directories, splits markdown into chunks (target 2000 chars, minimum 40), skips navigation-only headings, and supports oversized-text splitting.

The index store (src/index-store.ts) persists a SearchIndex to disk under $KAIOKEN_DIR/search-index, supports lexical-only or semantic (embedding-based) search, filters by kind, and materializes hits with snippets (240 chars) and 'via' tags.
A convenience search entry point (src/search.ts) exposes bm25Search which opens/loads the index and runs a lexical search, returning matching document paths.
